tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Explain WALoops setup, key types, available tool groups, API docs, and example OTP requests.

tools.name: send_otp
tools.description: Send an OTP to an international phone number. A free OTP key sends from the WALoops WhatsApp number; channel may be whatsapp or sms.

tools.name: verify_otp
tools.description: Verify a previously sent OTP using the recipient’s phone number and code.

tools.name: get_otp_usage
tools.description: Read OTP usage for the API key, including available usage or limits.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. List the client’s approved WhatsApp templates and their variables.

tools.name: send_template
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. Send an approved WhatsApp template; call list_templates first to confirm the template name and variables.

tools.name: get_dashboard_stats
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. Messages, conversations, automations and plan usage overview.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. List and search inbox conversations.

tools.name: get_conversation_messages
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. List messages in a conversation.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. List automations, or fetch one automation with its run stats by id.

tools.name: list_connected_apps
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. Connected apps (Shopify, WooCommerce, etc.) with their app_key and available event_key triggers; call before create_automation_draft.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: Every action an automation can run (WhatsApp, Shopify, WooCommerce, webhook to any external tool, bot flows, tags) with the action_config each needs. Combine any trigger from list_connected_apps with any action.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. List proven ready-made automations that can be installed as safe drafts.

tools.name: list_bot_flows
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. List bot flows available as automation actions.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. List tags available as automation actions.

tools.name: install_recipe_draft
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. Installs a recipe as a switched-off draft for the owner to review.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. List campaigns, or fetch one campaign by id.

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. Creates a WhatsApp template and submits it to Meta for approval (usually minutes to a few hours). Check status later with list_templates.

tools.name: pause_automation
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. Switches an automation OFF. For safety, automations can only be turned ON by the account owner inside the WALoops app.

tools.name: create_automation_draft
tools.description: Requires an Advance plan key. Creates an automation as a DRAFT: saved switched OFF and named "[AI draft] ...". Nothing is sent until the account owner reviews it and turns it on in the WALoops app (Automations page). Tell the user this.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_dashboard_stats, list_conversations, get_conversation_messages · Private data: get_otp_usage · Public sink: send_otp, send_template, list_actions · Destructive: list_automations, list_actions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_dashboard_stats, list_conversations, get_conversation_messages · Private data: get_otp_usage · Public sink: send_otp, send_template, list_actions · Destructive: list_automations, list_actions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
